title: Create a Sensor Class
instructions:
Complete the `Sensor` class so it has a primary constructor with two properties:
- `name` of type `String` (read-only)
- `port` of type `Int` (read-only)

Then in `main()`, create a Sensor called "Gyro" on port 0 and print its name and port on separate lines.
hint: Put `val name: String, val port: Int` inside the parentheses after the class name. Then create an instance with `Sensor("Gyro", 0)` and use `println`.
